text:
Your worst year taught you more than your best. You just never looked.

Every failure has a lesson buried in it. Worth more than the loss.

But most men run the 'survive and forget' move. Feel bad. Wait it out. Move on. Same mistake six months later.

That's not bad luck. That's a pattern you chose.

After every loss: write down what went wrong and what you will do different next time. One sentence.

Your losses teach for free. You just have to stop skipping class.
caption:
Most men skip the one self improvement habit that matters: studying their losses. That mindset discipline is how men win.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
